pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Get $(bold)Molten Dreadsteel$() (temperature 1450) - produced through alloy recipes, or by smelting dreadsteel fragments and other ingredients$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of Molten Dreadsteel (1 ingot) to make Dreadsteel material$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T4$() - among the highest-tier materials of this mod.

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(l:traits/trait_dreadsteel)Dread$(): every sword swing releases a wide blade arc that pierces through enemies, ignoring armor; hits inflict Weakness, Blindness and Wither$(br2)Dreadsteel shines on both offense and defense: its sword and its armor each carry a dedicated trait (the armor one is "Dread Armor" - see the armor entry).
